column2: SIMOPS Ignition / Loss of Control - Construction hot work ignites hydrocarbon release during phased startup
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 23; CSA Z276 Clause 11; WCA s. 24
column8: 1. SIMOPS Management Procedure with physical segregation. 2. Daily Joint SIMOPS Coordination Meetings. 3. Gas monitoring and LEL sweeps for hot work within 15m.
column9: 1. Deploy mobile fire barriers and water curtains. 2. Assigned fire watches with radio to MCR.
column10: SIMOPS permit audits and LEL gas test log reviews (Daily by SIMOPS Coordinator).

column2: Introduction of Hydrocarbons (First Gas Leakage) - Loss of containment during initial gassing up of cold boxes/tanks
column7: BCER LNG Facility Regulation; CSA Z276 Clause 10; NFPA 59A
column8: 1. Pre-Start Safety Reviews (PSSR) before hydrocarbon entry. 2. Nitrogen/helium flange leak testing. 3. Establish controlled Red Zone.
column9: 1. 100% active F&G and ESD systems. 2. Emergency response teams on standby.
column10: Verify PSSR sign-offs and helium leak test logs (Pre-startup by Commissioning Manager).

column2: Bypassed Safety-Critical Elements (SCEs) - Hydrocarbons introduced while F&G or ESD are bypassed for testing
column7: BCER LNG Facility Regulation s. 4; CSA Z276 Clause 10.3; WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 10
column8: 1. SCE Bypass and Defeat Registry (Operations Director sign-off). 2. SIS Management of Change process. 3. Physical lockout keys for bypasses.
column9: 1. Portable gas detectors and visual watchstanding. 2. Local manual deluge overrides.
column10: Audit active DCS bypass register against physical bypass keys and SCE bypass permit authorization (Weekly by Process Safety Engineer).

column2: LOTO & Isolation Boundary Confusions - Construction crew works under construction LOTO while operations energizes system under operational PTW
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 10; NB OHS Reg 91-191 Sec 239-240
column8: 1. Golden Gate LOTO transition procedure. 2. Physically distinct padlocks (Red/Blue/Yellow). 3. Map and sign-off boundary isolation drawings (P&IDs) daily.
column9: 1. Mandatory walkdowns of isolation points before de-isolation. 2. 100% field verification of zero energy states.
column10: Field walkdowns and LOTO boundary box audits with physical padlock count (Daily during shift handover by Area Authority).

column2: Confined Space Entry (CSE) Transition Hazards - Worker enters vessel under old construction permit exposing to nitrogen purge or unisolated lines
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 9; NB OHS Reg 91-191 Sec 262.1-262.9
column8: 1. Mandate 100% operational CSE permit system once nitrogen/hydrocarbons are introduced. 2. Physical isolation (blinding) of all process lines. 3. Multi-level gas testing before entry.
column9: 1. Position dedicated sentry outside entrance with active communication. 2. Continuous ventilation and atmospheric monitoring.
column10: Review pre-entry gas test logs, verify physical line blinds, and check sentry log sheets (Pre-entry/Shiftly by EHS Inspector).

column2: Working Over or Near Water Falls - Personnel fall into water during jetty/terminal construction or mooring trials causing drowning/hypothermia
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Sec 20.10-20.12; NB OHS Reg 91-191 Sec 343-345
column8: 1. Install engineered handrails and netting on all terminal/jetty walkways. 2. 100% tie-off fall protection within 2m of edge. 3. Daily gangway checks.
column9: 1. Mandate Transport Canada-approved auto-inflating PFDs. 2. Dedicated rescue boat on standby. 3. Position lifebuoys and ladders every 50m.
column10: Inspect jetty handrails/safety net integrity and verify PFD water-activation cartridge inspection tags (Weekly by EHS Specialist).

column2: Nitrogen Asphyxiation during Purging - Nitrogen leak in enclosed spaces causing worker asphyxiation
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 9; WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 5
column8: 1. Nitrogen Purging Safety Procedure with ventilation criteria. 2. Warning barriers and signs at vents. 3. Positive pressure ventilation in adjacent buildings.
column9: 1. Personal O2 monitors for personnel. 2. Stage emergency retrieval systems (harnesses/tripods) and SCBAs.
column10: Calibrate personal O2 monitors and inspect warning barriers at purging discharge points (Daily by HSE Technician).

column2: Arc Flash / High Voltage Electrical Energization - Severe electrical fault or shock during utility startup
column7: Technical Safety BC; WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 19; CSA Z462
column8: 1. Electrical Energization Plan signed by P.Eng/TSBC. 2. Clear LOTO boundary transition. 3. Arc flash modeling and boundary labeling.
column9: 1. Certified Category 4 arc flash PPE and insulated tools. 2. Remote-actuated switching.
column10: Verify PE-signed energization permits and audit Category 4 arc-flash PPE compliance (Pre-energization / Daily by Electrical Superintendent).

column2: Toxic Refrigerant Release (Anhydrous Ammonia) - Ammonia release during cooling trials exposing workers
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 5; CSA Z276 Clause 11; BC Environmental Management Act
column8: 1. Mechanical integrity verification (UT/RT) before fill. 2. Pre-fill relief valve checks. 3. Fixed toxic detectors.
column9: 1. Water spray deluge systems to knock down vapors. 2. Stage Level A chemical suits.
column10: Calibrate fixed ammonia gas detectors and perform functional testing of water deluge spray systems (Monthly by Instrument Tech).

column2: Marine Terminal Mechanical / Loading Arm Failure - Loading arm failure during wet trials causing cryogenic spill
column7: Transport Canada Marine Safety; Canada Shipping Act; TERMPOL
column8: 1. Dry and cryogenic nitrogen testing of loading arms. 2. Daily calibration of ERC/ERS loops. 3. Mooring analysis and vessel vetting.
column9: 1. Automated dry-break isolation on ERS trigger. 2. Deploy water shield systems to protect hull.
column10: N/A

column2: Pneumatic or Hydrostatic Pressure Testing Rupture - Catastrophic failure under test pressure creating projectiles
column7: Technical Safety BC; WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Parts 10 & 23; ASME B31.3; CSA Z662
column8: 1. Exclusion boundaries based on stored energy. 2. Remote testing outside exclusion zones. 3. Maximize hydrotests; restrict pneumatics.
column9: 1. Whipchecks and restraints on manifolds. 2. Unobstructed emergency egress.
column10: Inspect hydrotest boundary barriers and verify transducer calibration certs (Pre-test by Test Engineer).

column2: Underwater Acoustic / Marine Mammal Disturbance - Marine operations exceed noise limits violating certificates
column7: BCEAO EA Condition 16; Fisheries Act (DFO); Squamish Nation SNEAA
column8: 1. Vessel speed limits (max 10 knots). 2. Marine Mammal Observers on terminal during docking. 3. Restrict thruster usage.
column9: 1. Implement 'Stop Work' protocol if mammal enters safety zone.
column10: Audit vessel speed logs and verify Marine Mammal Observer watch logs (Weekly by Environmental Lead).

column2: Excessive Flaring / Air Emission Violations - Startup trips cause high-volume flaring violating air permits
column7: BC Environmental Management Act; BCEAO; Squamish Nation SNEAA
column8: 1. Flare Minimization Plan. 2. Nitrogen/gas mixtures during cooling. 3. Keep local stakeholders/Nation informed.
column9: 1. High-efficiency flare tips with steam/air assist.
column10: Monitor flare flow meters in DCS and verify community notification logs (Daily by Environmental Supervisor).

column2: Operational Competency & Familiarity Gaps - Operator fails to react to startup anomalies causing equipment failure
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg s. 23.3; CSA Z276 Clause 11.2
column8: 1. Dynamic simulator training (OTS) for shift personnel. 2. Shadowing experienced commissioning engineers. 3. Complete, approved SOPs.
column9: 1. Stage vendor specialists on-site. 2. Enforce fatigue management policy.
column10: Audit Control Room Operator simulator certification records and verify shift fatigue logs (Monthly by Operations Director).

column2: Thermal Shock & Cryogenic Piping Fatigue - Rapid cooldown causes extreme thermal shock bowing/cracking piping
column7: BCER LNG Facility Reg; CSA Z276 Clause 11.5; ASME B31.3
column8: 1. Enforce cooldown rate limits (max 10C/hr) via skin thermocouples. 2. Check spring hangers/pipe supports for contraction room. 3. DCS interlocks to shut off feed if rate exceeded.
column9: 1. Install gas-leak sensors beneath insulated flanges. 2. Pre-stage valves with remote ESD capability.
column10: Review DCS skin thermocouple temperature logs and verify spring hanger contraction room (Shiftly / Daily by Field Operator).

column2: Corrosion Under Insulation (CUI) Failure - Ingress of moisture under insulation causing pipe wall thinning and blowout
column7: BCER LNG Facility Reg; CSA Z276 Clause 11.5.1; API 570
column8: 1. CUI Inspection Program using non-destructive testing (pulsed eddy current). 2. Coating specs before insulation. 3. Weather-proof cladding seals.
column9: 1. Stage emergency clamp repair kits and repair crews. 2. Configure redundant process trains for isolation.
column10: Perform pulsed eddy current/profile radiography inspections and audit CUI registry (Annual by Inspection Engineer).

column2: Regulatory Delay / Leave to Open (LTO) Denial - Operational delays due to missing/incomplete safety records
column7: BCER ERAA s. 25; BCEAO; Squamish Nation SNEAA
column8: 1. Regulatory Compliance Matrix tracking all 25 prov / 51 fed conditions. 2. Continuous compilation of QA/QC/PSSR packs. 3. Bi-weekly alignment meetings.
column9: 1. Phased Leave to Open (LTO) submissions.
column10: Audit Provincial/Federal Compliance Matrix status and QA/QC document pack reviews (Bi-weekly by Regulatory Manager).

column2: SIMOPS Critical Lifting Operations / Rigging Failure - Rigging failure or crane tip-over during modular lifts strikes personnel or live process systems
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 14; CSA Z150; IOGP Life-Saving Rules
column8: 1. PE-stamped Critical Lift Plan for loads >75% crane capacity or lifting over live equipment. 2. 100% verification of rigging gear certifications before mobilization.
column9: 1. Physical barricading of lift zones (Red Zone) to prevent line-of-fire exposure. 2. Mandatory Stop Work if wind speeds exceed site crane limits.
column10: Verify PE-stamped critical lift plans and check crane rigging certificates (Pre-lift by Rigging Supervisor).

column2: Mobile Equipment & Site Vehicle Collisions - Collision between mobile equipment/vehicles and pedestrians or rollover in tight zones
column7: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 16; IOGP Life-Saving Rules
column8: 1. Physically separated pedestrian walkways using concrete barriers. 2. Enforced site speed limit of 15 km/h with vehicle GPS monitoring.
column9: 1. Roll-over protective structures (ROPS) on all heavy equipment. 2. Dedicated traffic controllers (spotters) for backing operations.
column10: Verify mobile equipment GPS speed compliance records and check pedestrian barrier integrity (Weekly by HSE Specialist).

column2: Rapid Phase Transition (RPT) / Cryogenic Spill on Water - LNG spill onto seawater during loading/transit triggers physical explosion due to rapid boiling
column7: BC Energy Regulator (BCER) LNG Facility Regulation; CSA Z276 Clause 11; Transport Canada Marine Safety
column8: 1. Quick-release Emergency Release Systems (ERS) on loading arms with automatic dry-break couplers. 2. Structural containment barriers (drip trays) to prevent LNG from reaching seawater splash zone.
column9: 1. Automated seawater thermal barrier spray systems. 2. Maintain 100% active marine exclusion zone.
column10: Functional loop test of loading arm ERS and check seawater curtain thermal barrier flow (Pre-loading by Terminal Supervisor).

column2: BLEVE of Refrigerant Storage (Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion) - External fire exposure to pressurized refrigerant vessels leads to vessel shell failure and catastrophic rupture
column7: BCER LNG Facility Regulation; CSA Z276 Clause 10; Technical Safety BC
column8: 1. Apply certified passive fireproofing (PFP) insulation to vessel supports. 2. Double-barrier process control loops on vessel level and pressure.
column9: 1. Automatic High-Volume Water Deluge cooling systems. 2. Remote-actuated emergency depressurization (blowdown) systems.
column10: Verify passive fireproofing (PFP) thickness coating checks and test automatic vessel deluge loops (Annual by Maintenance Inspector).

column2: LNG Storage Tank Rollover - Stratification/layering of LNG of different densities/temperatures leads to sudden mixing and massive boil-off overpressurizing tank
column7: CSA Z276 Clause 7; NFPA 59A
column8: 1. Dual-nozzle filling systems (top and bottom filling) to promote continuous mixing. 2. Multi-point density and temperature profiling system (LTMS) at 1m intervals.
column9: 1. Automatic Boil-Off Gas (BOG) compressor override systems. 2. Pre-program emergency gas-to-flare routing if pressures exceed limits.
column10: Verify DCS tank density/temperature profile tracking and BOG compressor interlocks (Shiftly by Control Room Operator).

column2: Cryogenic Embrittlement & Structural Collapse - Cryogenic liquid leak contacts carbon steel structural supports causing immediate cold embrittlement and collapse
column7: CSA Z276 Clause 5; ASME B31.3
column8: 1. Clad critical carbon steel support members with Cryogenic Spill Protection (CSP) epoxy. 2. Install engineered cryogenic deflection shields and drip trays.
column9: 1. Install low-temperature fiber-optic leak detection loops. 2. Maintain rapid-isolation ESD valves.
column10: Perform fiber-optic leak detection loop testing and inspect drip tray integrity (Monthly by Asset Integrity Tech).

column2: Process Alarm Flooding & Operator Cognitive Overload - DCS floods operators with hundreds of alarms in minutes during process upsets causing them to miss critical warnings
column7: CSA Z276 Clause 11.2; ISA-18.2
column8: 1. Enforce strict Alarm Rationalization Program in accordance with ISA-18.2. 2. Implement dynamic alarm suppression/shelving during major trips.
column9: 1. Deploy High-Performance HMI design. 2. Set up automated safety-instrumented shutdown systems (SIS).
column10: Perform alarm rate auditing and test dynamic alarm suppression logic (Quarterly by Automation Engineer).

column2: Hydrate / Ice Plug Formation & Piping Rupture - Moisture ingress into dry gas/cryogenic piping forms ice/hydrate plugs causing local blockage and piping rupture
column7: CSA Z276 Clause 11.5; ASME B31.3
column8: 1. Maintain continuous moisture analyzer monitoring on dry gas feed loop. 2. Run regular regeneration cycles on molecular sieve dehydration beds.
column9: 1. Pre-stage chemical injection ports (methanol/glycol). 2. Mandate slow, controlled depressurization procedures.
column10: Monitor dehydration loop moisture analyzers in DCS and test methanol injection ports (Daily / Shiftly by CRO).

column2: Turnaround & Shutdown Isolation Failures - Work performed under incorrect/bypassed isolations during turnarounds causes toxic exposure
column8: CRITICAL (20)
column9: WorkSafeBC OHS Reg Part 10; NB OHS Reg 91-191 Sec 239-240
column10: Conduct turnaround safety audits, double-isolation (DBB) line walkdowns, and verify blind lists (Daily during turnaround by Area Authority).
column11: 1. Enforce digitized, software-tracked PTW/LOTO system with physical validation. 2. Mandate double block and bleed (DBB) or blinding of hydrocarbon lines.
column12: 1. Require independent third-party verification audits on turnaround isolations. 2. Maintain active safety patrols and gas-testing sweeps.

column2: Marine Vessel Collision at Jetty - LNG carrier or tug loses propulsion/steering and collides with jetty causing loading arm rupture and gas release
column7: Transport Canada Marine Safety; Canada Shipping Act; TERMPOL
column8: 1. Mandate harbor pilots and escort tugs. 2. Install laser docking and jetty-mounted wind/wave monitoring.
column9: 1. Quick-Release Hooks (QRHs) with remote release and tension sensors. 2. Automatic ESD trigger upon mooring tension limit breach.
column10: Inspect laser docking system calibration records and check Quick-Release Hook tension monitors (Monthly by Marine Engineer).
